title: Scalar geometric series in the real and complex fields
statement:
Work over $\mathbf C$ and $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], with their usual absolute values. If $q\in\mathbf C$ and $|q|<1$, then
$$\sum_{n\geq0}q^n=(1-q)^{-1}.$$
The series is absolutely convergent, and $\sum_{n\geq0}|q|^n=(1-|q|)^{-1}$. In particular, for every real $0\leq b<1$, $\sum_{n\geq0}b^n=(1-b)^{-1}$, with convergence of the net of sums over finite subsets.
